scripts.speaker: Valkyrie
scripts.text:
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.

scripts.speaker: Valkyrie
scripts.text:
Please make
yourself comfortable
while you are here.
Honor to the warriors!

scripts.speaker: Valkyrie
scripts.text:
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.

scripts.speaker: Valkyrie
scripts.text:
You will now end
your present life and
begin an entirely new life.
Honor to the warriors!

scripts.speaker: Valkyrie
scripts.text:
There are a few things you must
do before we start. You must
first empty your mind and body.
Honor comes when you abandon
all your selfish desires...

scripts.speaker: Valkyrie
scripts.text: You cannot take anything with you to the next life. Your items, zeny, pets and Pushcart all have to be left behind.

scripts.speaker: Valkyrie
scripts.text:
When you are ready
please return to me,
brave adventurer.

scripts.speaker: Valkyrie
scripts.text:
I see you've already
released yourself from
all worldy attachments,
{0}.

scripts.speaker: Valkyrie
scripts.text: That's an admirable attitude for an adventurer such as yourself. Honor comes when you abandon all personal desires for the sake of mankind.

scripts.speaker: Valkyrie
scripts.text:
Hmm... I sense that you have
some lingering attachment or
unfinished business in your
current life. Take care of that,
and bring closure to your present life.

scripts.speaker: Valkyrie
scripts.text:
Now, let me remove all
of your present memories...
However, you will be able to
remember the most honorable
moments of this life.

scripts.speaker: Valkyrie
scripts.text:
With one,
I will ask the
goddess Urd to remove
all of your present
memories.

scripts.speaker: Valkyrie
scripts.text:
With two,
I will ask the
goddess Verdandi to keep
and record the most honorable moments of your present life.

scripts.speaker: Valkyrie
scripts.text:
With three,
I will ask the
goddess Skuld to
guide you to your
next life.

scripts.speaker: Valkyrie
scripts.text: One...

scripts.speaker: Valkyrie
scripts.text:
One...
Two......

scripts.speaker: Valkyrie
scripts.text:
One...
Two......
And Three.

scripts.speaker: Valkyrie
scripts.text:
Congratulations.
You are now reborn
into a brand new life.
Please take these small gifts
in preparation for your new adventures.

scripts.speaker: Valkyrie
scripts.text: I wish that the release the goddess Urd has granted you proves to be a blessing. I hope that the memories Verdandi has recorded will always honor you.

scripts.speaker: Valkyrie
scripts.text: And I pray that the new life to which the goddess Skuld will guide you will be even more honorable than your last.

scripts.speaker: Valkyrie
scripts.text:
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.

scripts.speaker: Valkyrie
scripts.text: Unfortunately, you have not yet been invited here. I ask you to leave immediately. Honor to the warriors!

scripts.speaker: Metheus Sylphe
scripts.text:
Welcome to the Library of the Schweicherbil Magic Academy.
I assume you have come here
to read the 'Book of Ymir.'

scripts.speaker: Metheus Sylphe
scripts.text: Unfortunately, the original copy of the book has been damaged over time. We currently only allow the public to view a copy of the book.

scripts.speaker: Metheus Sylphe
scripts.text: Also, in order to preserve the original 'Book of Ymir,' we have decided to accept donations from people who wish to read the copy we have provided.

scripts.speaker: Metheus Sylphe
scripts.text:
The suggested
donation amount is
1,285,000 zeny.
Donate.
Cancel.

scripts.speaker: Metheus Sylphe
scripts.text:
Thank you, your donation will be used for a good cause. You may
now go in and read the book.

scripts.speaker: Metheus Sylphe
scripts.text: Unfortunately, you don't seem to possess enough zeny at the moment. Please check your funds and come back again.

scripts.speaker: Metheus Sylphe
scripts.text:
Take your time, and
enjoy your travels.

scripts.speaker: Metheus Sylphe
scripts.text: Once again, thank you for your generous donation. Feel free to read a carbon copy of the 'Book of Ymir' at your leisure.

scripts.speaker: Metheus Sylphe
scripts.text:
Welcome to the Library of the Schweicherbil Magic Academy.
Here, we have a countless number of books. Please take your time and look around.

scripts.speaker: The Book of Ymir
scripts.text: ...The entrance to the Hall of Honor is open to anyone who has moved forward into their next life. It is there to help heroes decide what they want to do, and can lead them to anywhere in this world.

scripts.speaker: The Book of Ymir
scripts.text: In the Hall of Honor, everything is prepared for heroes. It is rumored that any wish that cannot be fulfilled in our reality can be realized in the Hall of Honor.
Stop reading.
Continue reading.

scripts.speaker: The Book of Ymir
scripts.text: There is a forgotten path which leads to the Hall of Honor, the closest place to the heavens. The ordinary will never discover this place...

scripts.speaker: The Book of Ymir
scripts.text:
...Therefore, ancient heroes were
always in anguish, knowing that
eventually, they were mortal and
would pass from this realm...

scripts.speaker: The Book of Ymir
scripts.text:
There were no documents,
songs, or remaining folklore that had any information on life after death. However, I recently uncovered an old scroll
about Valkyrie...

scripts.speaker: The Book of Ymir
scripts.text:
Valkyrie...
The legendary
guardian angel.
Angel of Ragnarok.

scripts.speaker: The Book of Ymir
scripts.text:
Adventurers of great strength
and bravery will be lead by
Valkyrie to Valhalla, the Hall
of Honor. There, they will be
given a new life.

scripts.speaker: The Book of Ymir
scripts.text:
Reborn, they will live again as
even greater heroes that will
brighten the world. Bodies that
were exhausted will be filled
with energy...

scripts.speaker: The Book of Ymir
scripts.text: And their souls will be given abilities with the heart of Ymir. However, the heart of Ymir was totally destroyed and scattered all over the world after the battle for Rune-Midgarts.

scripts.speaker: The Book of Ymir
scripts.text:
I have found a small amount of
Ymir heart pieces over a long
long period of time. But I can't
confirm if the story of Valkyrie
and Valhalla is true just
through scientific tests.

scripts.speaker: The Book of Ymir
scripts.text:
So, I am leaving this record in hope that someone in the future
can confirm that Valkyrie and Valhalla actually exist...

scripts.speaker: The Book of Ymir
scripts.text:
Let the heroes live new lives
so they can protect the world
from danger. And then...

scripts.speaker: Teleporter
scripts.text:
Congratulations.
Honor to the warriors!

scripts.speaker: Teleporter
scripts.text:
Please refrain
from touching any
of the exhibitions.
..........

scripts.speaker: Teleporter
scripts.text:
Honorable one,
which place do you wish to go?
Prontera
Morocc
Payon
Geffen
Alberta
Izlude
Al De Baran
Comodo
Juno

scripts.speaker: Teleporter
scripts.text: Have a nice trip.
